short: how a medical finding usually turns out
notes: Second round; the first ('medically harmless') failed because ' are' in plain medical statements fired in near misses, including 'usually dangerous'. Probes: ' are' after 'Most heart murmurs in children' 0.45, 'Many patients with small cysts' 0.59; 'Most paintings in museums' 0.02; 'Enzyme rises like this are usually' 0.04. Near misses keep the sentence frame in other topics.
